canAnswer.ungraded: You're playing without grading, so there are no measurements to answer questions about your Takes from.

card.tooShort: Take {{take}} stopped after {{bars}} bars, too few to judge.

slip.none: No bar slipped in Take {{take}}: every bar that could be judged held.
slip.noBars: I didn't measure Take {{take}} bar by bar, so I can't say where it slipped.

premise.early: In Take {{take}} your notes landed early, not late.
premise.late: In Take {{take}} your notes landed late, not early.

premiseNone.early: Take {{take}} didn't lean early: no bar was more than {{ms}} ms off the rest of it.
premiseNone.late: Take {{take}} didn't lean late: no bar was more than {{ms}} ms off the rest of it.

bar.early: Bar {{bar}} of the tune: {{ms}} ms earlier than the rest of the Take.
bar.late: Bar {{bar}} of the tune: {{ms}} ms later than the rest of the Take.

lean.none: No bar of Take {{take}} leaned early or late by more than {{ms}} ms.
lean.notMeasured: I didn't measure which way Take {{take}} leaned: there is no note-by-note timing for it.

count.passed: Take {{take}} did count: it met the pass mark at {{bpm}} BPM.
count.below: Take {{take}} did count, as a Take below the pass mark at {{bpm}} BPM.
count.notCaught: I didn't measure Take {{take}}: I heard {{heard}} of {{expected}} notes, too few to grade, so it doesn't count against you.
count.tooShort: Take {{take}} stopped after {{bars}} bars, too short to judge, so it doesn't count either way.
count.unfair: You marked this grade as not fair. It is kept as measured, with your answer beside it.
count.pitchGraded: The pitch of your notes is part of this Exercise's grade.

ungraded.eyes: I didn't measure Take {{take}}: it was the one for your eyes, so nothing was graded.
ungraded.chosen: I didn't measure Take {{take}}: you chose to just play it, so nothing was graded.
ungraded.inputOff: I didn't measure Take {{take}}: the input wasn't on, so nothing was graded.
ungraded.gradingOff: I didn't measure Take {{take}}: grading is off, so nothing was graded.

notMeasured.pitch: I didn't measure that. This Exercise times your notes and doesn't check their pitch.
notMeasured.pickDirection: I didn't measure that. The app has only sound, and a downstroke and an upstroke can sound alike.
notMeasured.muting: I didn't measure that. The app can't tell a muted string from a loud one next to it.
notMeasured.posture: I didn't measure that. The app has no picture of you.
notMeasured.tension: I didn't measure that. Only you can feel tension, and it comes before it can be heard.
notMeasured.handAttribution: I didn't measure that. A late note sounds the same from either hand.
notMeasured.fingering: I didn't measure that. The same pitch sounds the same from any finger.
notMeasured.tone: I didn't measure that. Tone and touch aren't measured.
notMeasured.feel: I didn't measure that. Whether it sounds good isn't something the app measures.

notNow.noTake: There's no Take of this Exercise to answer from yet.
notNow.ungraded: You're playing without grading, so I didn't measure anything to answer that from.
